name: David McAllister - Après le § 92 - Am 84
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 92a. Welcomes the successful Swedish-Somali cooperation on returns, which has enabled orderly repatriations of individuals from Sweden and other EU Member States to Somalia; considers that this bilateral agreement strengthens the credibility of the asylum system, upholds the rule of law and serves as a constructive model for responsible returns of migrants to countries of origin;
